headline: BirlaNu Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - BirlaNu Limited has informed the Exchange about Sanction of Scheme of Amalgamation between Clean Coats Private Limited with BirlaNu Limited and their respective Members.
